## ADMIN & INFRASTRUCTURE (Do Once)

### Email & Security
- [ ] Create dedicated email: <pattern>@<domain>
- [ ] Enable 2FA on ALL platforms
- [ ] Password manager: unique passwords per site
- [ ] Save recovery codes offline

### Payout Setup
- [ ] PayPal: verify account, link bank, confirm email
- [ ] Bank account: for direct transfers (<Platforms>)
- [ ] Crypto wallet (optional): for <Platform> crypto payouts
- [ ] Set low payout thresholds where possible

### Tracking
- [ ] Import `templates/<daily>_tracker.csv` → Google Sheets/Excel
- [ ] Add tabs: Monthly Summary, Tax Tracker, <Specific> Log
- [ ] Bookmark `references/platform_links.md` in browser
- [ ] Print `templates/<routine>_planner.md` ×4 (one per week)

### Tax Prep (<Jurisdiction>)

## RED FLAGS — STOP IF YOU SEE

- ❌ "Pay £X to unlock jobs"
- ❌ "Guaranteed £X,000/month"
- ❌ Requests for passport/selfie upfront
- ❌ No Trustpilot / < 3 stars / < 50 reviews
- ❌ Domain < 6 months old for "established" claims
- ❌ Only crypto payout, no PayPal/bank
- ❌ Pressure: "Only 3 spots left!"

---

## WEEK 1 SPRINT (Complete in Order)

**Day 1:** Tier 1 items 1–2 + Admin: Email + Password Manager
**Day 2:** Tier 1 item 3 + Tier 2 item 4 + Admin: Payout Setup
**Day 3:** Tier 2 item 5 + Tier 3: Core sites (all)
**Day 4:** Complete first welcome offers / first tasks
**Day 5:** Cash out ALL instant-payout platforms
**Day 6:** Review tracker, verify all payouts arrived
